missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вера' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Крепкая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive model for an abstract noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Веру' is the feminine accusative, the direct object of 'укрепили'. 'Трудности' is the nominative plural subject. A meaningful cause-effect pattern.

missions.phrase: У него нет веры в успех.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Веры' is the genitive required by 'нет'. 'В успех' is the accusative naming the object of faith. A core negation pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Вере' is the dative governed by 'верны' (faithful to). 'Своей' agrees in the feminine dative. A strong model for loyalty language.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Верой' is the instrumental expressing what he lives by. 'В добро' is the accusative naming the object of faith. A heartfelt instrumental model.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В её вере' uses the prepositional 'вере' after 'в' to locate a quality. 'Много силы' uses the genitive of quantity. A reflective pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Без веры' uses the genitive 'веры' after 'без' to express absence. 'Жить' is the infinitive subject. A strong existential statement.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о вере и надежде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О вере' uses the prepositional 'вере' after 'о', joined to 'надежде' by 'и'. Both nouns share the prepositional. A reflective discussion frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вера' is the nominative subject of 'помогает', which governs the dative 'людям'. 'В беде' is the prepositional location. A natural supportive statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Веру' is the feminine accusative, the direct object of 'потеряла'. 'В людей' is the accusative naming the object of faith. A common emotional pattern.
